_readme: One entry per project, in display order. The homepage and menu show the first three with "featured": true; "hidden": true keeps an entry out of the site entirely. To add a project: put its photos in _src/projects/<slug>/ (they become pictures named <slug>-01, <slug>-02… in file-name order), run `npm run media`, add an entry here, then run `npm run projects` to generate its page. Gallery blocks are "wide" (one photo) or "pair" (portrait first, then landscape); any picture name from src/media-manifest.json can be used. Leave unknown fields empty: the site shows them as [NEEDS COPY] rather than inventing anything.

projects.name: Akhil & Sanjana Residence
projects.title:
Akhil & Sanjana
Residence
projects.coverAlt: The living room at dusk: rounded grey sofas around two timber coffee tables, and glass doors open to the city beyond.
projects.lead: A home full of colour and books, looking out over the city: a library wall lit from within, a listening room with floor-standing speakers, and a balcony that glows after dark.

pics.alt: The family room: orange velvet seats around a low table, a curved sofa and a wall-mounted screen beneath a timber ceiling.
A bar corner papered in a botanical print, with a yellow refrigerator and coral bar stools under black pendants.
Across the living room to the bar: a large floral painting, a bronze sculpture and the coral bar counter beyond.
A listening room: floor-standing speakers either side of an AV console and turntable, a large painting above and a leather recliner.
A cluster of woven pendant lights hanging in the stairwell.
The upper landing, its pendant cluster lighting the stair below.
A library of floor-to-ceiling shelves, lit from within, around a sofa with a pink arm.
The dining room: a pink still-life painting above the table and a ring of light overhead.
The balcony by day: a striped two-seater, planters and the city skyline.
The same balcony at night, its wall lights on and the city lit up below.

projects.name: Dr Akhil & Sunitha Residence

Residence
projects.coverAlt: The house from its forecourt: white volumes under deep timber-lined eaves, a cantilevered porch and a sculpted bonsai beside the steps.
projects.lead: A house in a landscaped garden, with a dedicated home theatre, a living room under a hexagonal ring pendant and a bedroom that looks out over the water.

pics.alt: The entrance: broad stone steps under a timber-lined canopy on slender columns.
A floating timber-and-glass staircase against a stone wall, traced by a single line of light.
The living room by day: tan leather sofas, a marble feature wall and the hexagonal pendant overhead.
The living room under its hexagonal ring pendant, with the stairwell and a large painting beyond.
The hexagonal pendant above a leather sofa and a round backlit mirror.
The family lounge: a white media wall, a linear chandelier and soft seating around a round table.
The dedicated home theatre: two rows of leather recliners in a fabric-lined room edged with a warm cove of light.
Wire pendants hanging in the double-height stairwell, sheer curtains behind.
The long dining table by day, a crystal chandelier above and the courtyard beyond.
The dining room in the evening, its ceiling cove and chandelier lit.
A round backlit mirror reflecting the hexagonal pendant, beside a leather sofa.
A lounge with a curved cream sofa and a lit display niche.
A bedroom with floor-to-ceiling glass looking out over trees and the lake.
The garden: a deep porch canopy, flowering shrubs and a stepping-stone path across the lawn.

projects.lead: A home drawn in warm, layered light: stepped ceiling coves throughout, a backlit stone wall behind the main bed and a glowing stone splashback in the kitchen.

pics.alt: From the sofa to the media wall: a woven cream sectional, a timber wall unit and glass-leaf chandeliers.
The living room in portrait: the chandelier in its cove above a cream sofa and the media wall.
The dining table in front of the media wall, a cluster of pendants overhead.
The kitchen: a backlit stone splashback, light beneath the cabinets and timber joinery.
A passage with a lit display cabinet.
The hob against the glowing stone splashback, the dining area beyond.
The lounge seen across the room, warm cove light washing the curtains and walls.
The lounge in portrait: the ceiling cove glowing above the curtains and the chandelier.
The lounge from its far end, a pendant of glass spheres above the sofa.
The main bedroom: a backlit stone wall behind the bed, a ceiling cove and a timber floor.
A bedroom with a single pendant beside the bed and curtains lit from above.
A bedroom with a study desk, panelled walls and curtains washed with light.
A bedroom with a sculpted plaster wall behind the bed, softly lit from a ceiling cove.
A bedroom with a fluted headboard, a pendant light and a mirrored wardrobe.
